title: Symmetric Tree
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, check whether it is a mirror of itself (i.e., symmetric around its center).
inputFormat: A single line containing space-separated strings representing the level-order traversal of the tree.
outputFormat: Print `YES` if the tree is symmetric, `NO` otherwise.
constraints:
1 <= The number of nodes in the tree <= 1000
-100 <= Node.val <= 100

examples.explanation: The left and right subtrees mirror each other identically.

starterCode.python:
import sys
line = sys.stdin.read().split()
# Implement symmetric tree logic
